text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks at gains, which felt satisfying, but I should avoid selling just to lock in a win; decide based on the stock’s prospects and my plan, not my average cost.","Losses feel especially painful, and I may resist admitting a purchase was wrong. I should review each holding objectively and sell when its reason for owning it no longer holds.","Checking daily can tempt me to trade on short-term moves. I should focus on longer-term goals and avoid unnecessary trades."]}
